faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow position is 26th August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech in Environmental Engineering. Preferably, they should have experience in water, wastewater & sludge sampling & analysis and operation of water/wastewater/sludge treatment Pilot Plant, along with a valid GATE scorecard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000 plus HRA. This is a contractual position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment drive by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 27th August 2026. Candidates are advised to be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.
